name: get_minutes
title: Get minutes
description: Return one minutes version of a meeting as markdown. `version` selects which one (defaults to the latest); `available_versions` lists every generated version in ascending order. Versions are append-only: regenerate appends a new version and never overwrites an existing one, so a version, once returned, is stable. `generated_at` and `provider` (LLM provider registry name; none = plain minutes) describe how this version was produced. `unresolved_speakers` lists the speaker labels that could not be resolved to real names (rendered as 話者不明 in the markdown). `scope` is the scope selector (default deny): omitted = only unscoped meetings; a single name = that scope + unscoped; an array of 2+ names = explicit cross-scope lookup (audit-logged). Read-only. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting, unknown version, or no minutes generated yet — check get_meeting.minutes_versions and the processing job), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), invalid_argument, internal.

version.description: Minutes version to return (see available_versions / get_meeting.minutes_versions). Defaults to the latest version.

scope.description: Omitted = unscoped meetings only. One name = that scope + unscoped. Array of 2+ names = cross-scope lookup (audit-logged).

generated_at.description: UTC time this version was generated.

provider.description: LLM provider registry name used for generation (none = plain minutes).

unresolved_speakers.description: Speaker labels without a resolved name (shown as 話者不明 in the markdown).
